rationale: The revision adds a pivot candidate and a Grover threshold/maximum-finding plan, but does not specify a concrete threshold predicate with its update rule or an ordered full-state selector. Exact binary64, special-state and success-policy obligations remain open. Do not substitute a reviewer-written global-maximum formula or ordered scan. This is increased candidate/plan coverage, not a checked pivot repair. The supplied insufficient-evidence feedback itself named pivot selection, so any nomination change also has a task-specific cue confound and cannot be attributed solely to executing a semantic counterexample.
